w2kgph:404: CAISI (Center for AI Standards and Innovation) uses Item Response Theory to compute Elo scores across 9 different benchmarks, assessing the gap between open models like DeepSeek V4 and U.S. frontier models. These benchmark-specific outliers have an outsized impact on the overall Elo, amplifying the perceived magnitude of the capability gap.
